intent: Archive the OOPSLA 2026 async/await design-space paper, map its nine dimensions onto Rust Future and Tokio/Smol, and provide a C11 executable model with exact behavior anchors and a Rust oracle.

findings.title: Detach anchor overstates runtime ownership
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the C anchor to handle-drop-does-not-abort and state that caller-owned task/state storage remains alive; keep Tokio cross-scope detachment as an upstream-documented contract.
findings.first_evidence: learning/studies/20260910-async-await-design-space/demo/src/async_examples.c:192-195 -- executor, handle, task, and event state are local variables in one stack frame.
findings.why_it_matters: The C trace stays green because task and future storage remain live in the caller's frame, not because the executor owns them across scopes. Narrowing the anchor prevents the study from claiming a Tokio lifetime property that the demo does not implement.
evidence: learning/studies/20260910-async-await-design-space/demo/src/async_examples.c:192-195 -- executor, handle, task, and event state are local variables in one stack frame.
learning/studies/20260910-async-await-design-space/README.md:360 -- the original anchor claimed a runtime-owned task continued.

findings.title: Cascade: saturated queue strands cancellation cleanup
findings.suggested_fix: Bound active tasks to the ready-queue capacity so one queue slot is available for every live task, then add a saturation cleanup test.
findings.why_it_matters: With more live tasks than queue slots, abort can set cancel_requested and lose the enqueue that is required to execute drop cleanup. Bounding active tasks to queue capacity removes that reachable state instead of asking callers to recover a lost wake.
evidence: learning/studies/20260910-async-await-design-space/demo/src/mini_async.c:12-14 -- a full queue returns false without queuing the task.

findings.title: Completed self-wake exhausts poll budget
findings.suggested_fix: Discard completed queue entries before enforcing max_polls and add an exact-boundary self-wake regression test.
findings.first_evidence: learning/studies/20260910-async-await-design-space/demo/src/mini_async.c:91-101 -- the max_polls check precedes dequeuing and skipping completed tasks.
findings.why_it_matters: A legal wake followed by Ready leaves one stale queue entry. At the exact poll limit, the executor reports failure and leaves that entry queued even though the task completed; stale entries must be drained without consuming poll budget.
evidence: learning/studies/20260910-async-await-design-space/demo/src/mini_async.c:91-101 -- the max_polls check precedes dequeuing and skipping completed tasks.
learning/studies/20260910-async-await-design-space/demo/src/mini_async.c:118-121 -- Ready marks the task complete after a wake may already have queued it.

findings.title: Zig artifact checksum is not recorded
findings.suggested_fix: Record and verify the official Zig 0.16.0 macOS ARM64 archive SHA-256, plus the installed compiler binary digest and complete flags.
findings.why_it_matters: A version string alone cannot attest which downloaded LLVM frontend produced the evidence. Recording the platform artifact and digest satisfies the repository's compiler-provenance contract.
evidence: AGENTS.md:53-55 -- the repository requires Zig version, downloaded-artifact SHA-256, and full compile flags.

triage_groups.title: Executor lifecycle correctness
triage_groups.context: Both findings arise from ready-queue lifecycle bookkeeping.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Bound live tasks first (#3), then drain completed stale entries without poll budget (#4).
triage_groups.why: The active-task invariant prevents lost cancellation wakes; the stale-entry rule makes exact budgets truthful.

residual_risks: The Rust oracle is not registered with CTest, so CTest-only runs do not cover it.
The stored C waker contains a caller-managed task pointer and has no cross-scope invalidation protocol.
The executor is a deterministic single-thread teaching model; concurrent wake races remain outside scope.
testing_gaps: No cross-scope lifetime test because task/state storage is caller-owned.
